researchSummary.finding: Caersws DH maps to a real, active, legally-registered operation currently trading as Caersws Bike Park (legal entity: CAERSWS BIKE PARK LIMITED, Companies House no. 14802044, incorporated April 2023). The operation is a privately-owned downhill mountain biking venue and uplift service on farmland at Henblas, north of Caersws village, Powys, SY17 5JE. The internal project slug 'caersws-dh' reflects an older/informal brand name — the current primary trading name is 'Caersws Bike Park'. Core contact details (website, phone, email) are verified. One GPS coordinate discrepancy requires human resolution before data entry. Images are not freely licensed and must be obtained from the operator.

description.short: Caersws Bike Park is a privately-owned downhill mountain biking venue and uplift service set on farmland in Caersws, Powys, Mid Wales. Home to seven named trails ranging from red to triple black diamond, it runs Saracen-sponsored demo days and pre-booked Saturday uplift sessions throughout the season.

sources.description: Official website — confirmed live. Contact details (phone, email), address, uplift dates, trail info, café, bike hire. Primary source for all contact data.
Companies House — CAERSWS BIKE PARK LIMITED, company 14802044, active, SIC 93110. Incorporated 14 April 2023.
Companies House officers — Directors Matthew Philip Simmonds (active, appointed 2023-04-14) and John Edward Riddell (active, appointed 2023-11-01).
Saracen Bikes partnership announcement — confirms Matt Simmonds' background (ex-Madison Saracen professional racer), Saracen as headline sponsor, demo fleet (Ariel 60, Myst Pro, Myst Team).
Singletrack World — confirms Helfare Highway (Triple Black Diamond) opened 2024, collaboration with Matt Jones and Shimano UK, trail builders Alf Raynor and Gareth Brewin.
MoreDirt listing — confirms location GPS (52.5336, -3.4591), Henblas farm, venue history as race venue from 2004, 'Caersws DH Bikepark' name.
Trailforks region page — region ID 18387, confirmed in search index as 'Caersws DH Bikepark'. Direct fetch returned 403.
ProLine MTB coaching partner page — confirms phone 07972 194232, café name ('Stwff and Things'), nearest bike shop (Brooks Cycles, Welshpool), and proximity to Dyfi Bike Park (~30 min).
Facebook page — one of two FB pages found; appears to be the main bike park operational page.
Mountain Bike Rider (MBR) — news article about Matt Jones building Helfare Highway at Caersws Bike Park in Mid Wales. Confirms park location and partnership.
MBWales.com agents/venues page — confirmed NEGATIVE: Caersws Bike Park not listed among 20 venues.
Official uplift booking page — confirms Saturday 10am–4pm sessions, June–September 2026, pre-booking mandatory, full-face helmet and knee pads required.
